sections.title: DocuVoice
sections.text: DocuVoice. Turn any documentation into a multi-voice audio podcast. Built with Kiro spec-driven development + ElevenLabs APIs for ElevenHacks 5.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: What it does. Paste any GitHub README URL and DocuVoice generates a navigable audio podcast with different voices per section type.

sections.title: Tech Stack
sections.text: Tech Stack. Next.js 16 + TypeScript. ElevenLabs TTS, Sound Effects and Music APIs. ffmpeg for audio assembly.

sections.title: Run locally
sections.text: Run locally. Code samples are left out of this narration.

sections.title: Built with Kiro spec-driven development
sections.text: Built with Kiro spec-driven development. Requirements, design and tasks were all defined as specs first, then implemented by Kiro's AI agent. See .kiro/specs/ for the full specification. ElevenHacks CodeWithKiro
